what: On hover it grows to 1.02× and tilts -.6° (.45s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)), the inner text and images cycle through three noise displacement filters (seeds 3 · 10 · 17, grain .045, strength 3) at .125s each so they boil like a hand drawing, and nod between 1° ↔ -3° every .25s. On release it returns to place in .45s. Does nothing on touch or with reduced motion

options.cycle: Time for the three filters to cycle once (s), default .375
options.roughness: Noise grain (baseFrequency) — set by the document’s first part, default .045
options.wobble: Displacement strength (px) — set by the document’s first part, default 3

note: The boil filter is applied to the direct child (or to the element itself if there is none). Text and lines inside the button boil separately

from.where: index.html [data-sketch-hover] buttons · header links · section list · footer links (original sketch-hover 3 filters + sketch-hover-boil · rock keyframes)
